name: cabinet
description: Cabinet — a modern, self-hostable retro game library for web, desktop and TV.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cabinet/core && npm run build -w @cabinet/db && npm run build -w cabinet-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cabinet/core && npm run typecheck -w @cabinet/db && npm run typecheck -w cabinet-web && npm run typecheck -w cabinet-keyvault && npm run typecheck -w cabinet-desktop
scripts.keyvault: npm run build -w @cabinet/core >/dev/null && npm run build -w cabinet-keyvault >/dev/null && node tools/keyvault/dist/cli.js
scripts.test:keyvault: npm run build -w @cabinet/core && npm run build -w cabinet-keyvault && node tools/keyvault/dist/cli.js selftest
